tenets.title: Open-Source License Clean-Room Isolation
tenets.statutory_basis: 17 U.S.C. § 102(b); EU Software Directive 2009/24/EC Recital 11 & Art. 1(2); CJEU C-406/10 SAS Institute v World Programming
tenets.ruling: All repository generators (make_x01.py..make_x06.py, toolchain_uga.py) execute exclusively within the Python standard library (PSF-2.0) and emit independent geometric data tables. The generated artifacts (.step, .3mf, .glb, .dxf) are uncopyrightable functional mathematical facts released under CC0-1.0 / CC-BY-4.0. No copyleft libraries (GPL-2.0/GPL-3.0/AGPL-3.0) are linked, imported, or executed in the generator pipeline, guaranteeing that users and downstream developers incur zero reciprocal copyleft obligations.

tenets.title: International Open Standards & Patent-Pledge Sovereignty
tenets.statutory_basis: ISO/IEC 12113:2022 (glTF 2.0); ISO 10303-21 (STEP AP242); ISO/IEC 25422:2022 (3MF Core 1.2.3); Lanham Act 15 U.S.C. § 1115(b)(4); EU Trade Mark Regulation (EU) 2017/1001 Art. 14(1)(c)
tenets.ruling: Every generated 3D solid, mesh, and 2D drawing adheres strictly to published, royalty-free, patent-pledged international standards. Specifically: (a) .glb conforms to ISO/IEC 12113:2022 under the Khronos Royalty-Free Patent Pledge; (b) .step conforms to ISO 10303-21 AP242 B-Rep exchange; (c) .3mf conforms to 3MF Core 1.2.3 under the 3MF Consortium Patent Licensing Commitment; (d) .dxf is implemented via clean-room ASCII R2000 tagged group-code tables without proprietary CAD libraries.

tenets.title: Zero-Telemetry Data Sovereignty & Global Privacy Compliance
tenets.statutory_basis: EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR 2016/679); California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA); Brazil LGPD (Lei 13.709/2018); Mexico LFPDPPP; UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018
